title: Books by countrymen of the member
statementMd:
Count loans where the borrowed book's author comes from the UK.

Expected columns: `uk_loans`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS uk_loans FROM loans l JOIN books b ON b.id = l.book_id JOIN authors a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE a.country = 'UK';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
